intro: Government and IT sectors in North America, particularly the United States, were the primary targets in six articles from April 12 to April 29, 2026, tagged with kev. The coverage included four high-severity and two critical-severity vulnerabilities, with specific CVEs including CVE-2024-57726 (CVSS 9.9), CVE-2026-21643 (CVSS 9.1), CVE-2024-1708 (CVSS 8.4), CVE-2024-20662, and CVE-2024-21412. Managed service providers and the broader technology sector were also frequently affected.
